props.name: checkedIcon
props.description: Checked icon for all items; an item's own `checkedIcon` takes precedence.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initially selected item values when uncontrolled; also the selection restored when the
surrounding native form is reset.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: indeterminateIcon
props.description: Indeterminate icon for all items; an item's own `indeterminateIcon` takes precedence.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description:
Where the checkbox control sits relative to the label for every item (`'leading'`,
`'trailing'`, or `'hidden'` to visually hide the control, as in selectable cards).

props.name: items
props.description:
Options to render. A string is shorthand for an item whose `value` and `label` are that
string.

props.name: legend
props.description:
Legend that labels the group (rendered as a `<legend>` inside the `<fieldset>`). A `Field`
label takes precedence for `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called after the user toggles an item, with the full new array of selected item values
(previous values plus or minus the toggled one, in toggle order). Not called while the group
is `disabled` or `readOnly`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Visual layout direction.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description:
The `value` of every selected item (controlled). Leave it `undefined` for uncontrolled
state and update it from `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout of the options. `list` stacks plain checkbox rows with a gap. `card` renders each
option as a separate bordered, padded card that toggles when clicked anywhere. `table` joins
the options into one bordered block with shared edges, each row toggling when clicked
anywhere.

props.name: checkedIcon
props.description: Custom checked icon for this item. Overrides the group's `checkedIcon`.

props.name: description
props.description: Description rendered under the item's label.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether this item is disabled. A disabled item is skipped by the group's `required`
validation.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description:
Displays the item in the mixed state regardless of whether its `value` is selected.
Toggling it still adds or removes the `value` from the group's `value` array.

props.name: indeterminateIcon
props.description: Custom indeterminate icon for this item. Overrides the group's `indeterminateIcon`.

props.name: label
props.description: Label rendered beside the item's checkbox.

props.name: value
props.description:
Value of the item, added to the group's `value` array when selected and submitted as the
native checkbox value. Must be unique within the group (a duplicate logs a warning in
development). Falls back to the item's index as a string.
